sections.title: The victory of Canaan.

verses.text: And it came to pass; after the death of Moses, the servant of the Lord, the Lord spoke unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying:
“Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, thou and all this people, and go over this Jordan unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.”
“As I have given unto Moses, so I have given unto you; every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon have I given unto you.”
“From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun shall be your coast.”
“There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life; as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.”
“I will give unto them the land which I swore unto their fathers to give them; be strong and of a good courage.”
“As I commanded Moses, so shalt thou observe to do; for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.”

“This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.”
“Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.”
And Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying:

"In the midst of the encampment, to the people: The Lord your God, the God of your fathers, has given you a heritage, and to the land which He shall give you, until the third day, you shall cross over this Jordan to inherit it; prepare yourselves, saying, 'Let us go forth.'"
And he spoke to them, saying, "I have commanded you, O Reuben and Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, thus."
"The servant of the Lord, Moses, commanded you, saying: 'The Lord your God shall give you rest; and this land shall be given to you.'"

"Your wives and your children and your livestock shall dwell in the cities which Moses has given you beyond the Jordan; but you, all you mighty men of valor, shall pass before your brethren, armed, and help them."

"Our God, the Lord, shall not cease to give you rest until your brethren also inherit the land which the Lord your God shall give them; and afterward, each of you shall return to his possession, which Moses has given you, on the other side of the Jordan."
And they answered Joshua, saying, "All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us, we will go."
"Just as we heeded Moses in all things, so we will heed you; only may the Lord your God be with you, as He was with Moses."
"Whoever rebels against your command and does not heed your words in all that you command him, let him be put to death; only be strong and of good courage."

sections.title: And Jesus sent forth the messengers unto Jericho.

verses.text: የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ “ውጡና ምድሪቱን ኢያሪኮን እዩ” ብሎ ከሰጢም ሁለት ጐልማሶች ሰላዮችን በስውር ላከ። እነዚያም ሁለት ጐልማሶች ሄዱ፤ ወደ ኢያሪኮም ደረሱ፤ ረዓብ ወደሚሉአትም ዘማ ቤት ገቡ፤ በዚያም ዐደሩ።
ለኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ፥ “እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ሰላዮች ሀገራችንን ሊሰልሉ ወደዚህ በሌሊት ገቡ” ብለው ነገሩት።
የኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ፥ “ሀገራችንን ሁሉ ሊሰልሉ መጥተዋልና ወደ አንቺ የመጡትን በዚችም ሌሊት ወደ ቤትሽ የገቡትን ሰዎች አውጪ በሉአት” ብሎ ወደ ረዓብ ላከ።
ሴቲቱም ሁለቱን ሰዎች ወስዳ ሸሸገቻቸው፤ እርስዋም፥ “አዎን፥ ሰዎቹ ወደ እኔ መጡ፤ ከወዴት እንደ ሆኑ ግን አላወቅሁም፤
በሩም ሲዘጋ፥ ሲጨልምም ሰዎቹ ወጡ፤ ወዴት እንደ ሄዱ አላውቅም፤ ፈጥናችሁ ተከተሉአቸው፤ ምንአልባት ታገኙአቸው ይሆናል” አለቻቸው።
እርስዋ ግን ወደ ሰገነቱ አውጥታ በተከመረ እንጨት መካከል በቀርከሃ ጠቅልላ ደብቃቸው ነበር።
ሰዎቹም ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መሻገሪያ በሚወስደው መንገድ ተከተሉአቸው፤ በሩም ተቈለፈ።
እነዚህም ሳይተኙ ሴቲቱ ወደ እነርሱ ወደ ሰገነቱ ወጣች።
ሰዎቹንም እንዲህ አለቻቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር ምድሪቱን አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጣችሁ ዐወቅሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር እናንተን መፍራትን በላያችን አምጥትዋልና፥ በምድሪቱም የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ የተነሣ ቀልጠዋልና።
ከግብፅ ምድር በወጣችሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር የኤርትራን ባሕር በፊታችሁ እንዳደረቀ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በነበሩት፥ እናንተም ፈጽማችሁ ባጠፋችኋቸው በሁለቱ በአሞራውያን ነገሥታት፥ በሴዎንና በዐግ ያደረጋችሁትን ሰምተናል።

And this matter we have heard and rejoiced in our hearts; for your God, the Lord, is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other. Therefore, from you, not even one soul shall be lost.
Now, in the presence of the Lord, I beseech you; as I have shown you kindness, so you also show kindness to the house of my father, and give me a true sign.
The house of my father, and my mother, and my brothers, and all my household, deliver; and our lives from death deliver.”

And the men said, “For your sake we will be ready to give our lives to death.” And she said, “The Lord will show you kindness and truth, when He gives you the land.” And the men said, “If you do not declare this matter of ours, then we will show kindness and truth to you, as the Lord has dealt with us.”
And her house was built into the city wall, and she dwelt upon the wall; and she let down a cord through the window.
And she said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you; hide there for three days, until the pursuers return; afterward you may go your way.”
And the men answered her, “We will be free from this oath which you have made us swear.”

Behold, when we come into the land, you shall bind this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down; and you shall gather your father and your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household to your home.

And it shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be upon his own head, and we will be guiltless; but whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head if a hand is laid on him.
But if you tell this our business, then we will be free from the oath which you made us swear.”
And she said, "Let it be as your word"; and they were comforted; and they went away; and she looked towards the door and was troubled.
And they departed and went to the mountain; and they remained there for three days until they returned, and they did not find them on the way.
And the two men returned; and they came down from the mountain and went to Jonah, the son of Amittai; and they told him all that had befallen them.
And they said to Jonah, "Truly the Lord has delivered all the land into our hands; all the people who dwell in that land have melted away before us."

sections.title: Israel crossed over the Jordan River as they had been commanded.

verses.text: ኢያሱም ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ እርሱና እስራኤልም ሁሉ ከሰጢም ተጕዘው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጡ፤ ሳይሻገሩም በዚያ አደሩ።
ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ጸሓፊዎች በሰፈሩ መካከል ገቡ።
ለሕዝቡም እንዲህ ብለው ዐወጁ፥ “የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ሌዋውያንና ካህናት ተሸክመውት ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ከሰፈራችሁ ተነሥታችሁ ተከተሉት።
በእናንተና በታቦቱ መካከል ያለው ርቀት በስፍር ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ ያህል ይሁን፤ በዚህ መንገድ በፊት አልሄዳችሁበትምና የምትሄዱበትን መንገድ እንድታውቁ ወደ ታቦቱ አትቅረቡ።”
ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን፥ “ነገ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ ድንቅ ነገር ያደርጋልና ራሳችሁን አንጹ” አለ።
ኢያሱም ካህናቱን፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ተሸክማችሁ በሕዝቡ ፊት ሂዱ” ብሎ ተናገራቸው፤ ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ተሸክመው በሕዝቡ ፊት ሄዱ።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “ከሙሴ ጋር እንደ ሆንሁ እንዲሁ ከአንተ ጋር መሆኔን ያውቁ ዘንድ በዚህ ቀን በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ፊት ከፍ ከፍ አደርግህ ዘንድ እጀምራለሁ።
አሁንም አንተ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የሚሸከሙትን ካህናት በዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ዳር ስትደርሱ በዮርዳኖስ ውስጥ ቁሙ ብለህ እዘዝ” አለው።
ኢያሱም ለእስራኤል ልጆች፥ “ወደዚህ ቀርባችሁ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ” አለ።
ኢያሱም አለ፥ “ሕያው አምላክ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እርሱም ከፊታችሁ ከነዓናዊውን፥ ኬጤዎናዊውንም፥ ኤዌዎናዊውንም፥ ፌርዜዎናዊውንም፥ ጌርጌሴዎናዊውንም፥ አሞሬዎናዊውንም፥ ኢያቡሴዎናዊውንም ፈጽሞ እንዲያጠፋቸው በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ።
እነሆ፥ የምድር ሁሉ ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት በፊታችሁ ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገራለች።
አሁንም ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ዐሥራ ሁለት ሰዎችን ምረጡ፤ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሰው ይሁን።
እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የምድርን ሁሉ ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት እግር ጫማ በዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ውስጥ ሲቆም፥ የዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ይደርቃል፤ ከላይ የሚወርደውም ውኃ ይቆማል።”
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሕዝቡ ዮርዳኖስን ሊሻገሩ ከየድንኳናቸው በወጡ ጊዜ፥ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት በሕዝቡ ፊት ይሄዱ ነበር።
እንደ ክረምትና እንደ መከር ወራት ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስ እስከ ወሰኑ ሞልቶ ነበርና የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ተሸካሚዎቹ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ በገቡ ጊዜ፥ ታቦቱን የተሸከሙት የካህናቱ እግሮች በውኃዉ ዳር ሲጠልቁ፥
ከላይ የሚወርደው ውኃ ቆመ፤ እስከ ቀርያትያርም አውራጃ እጅግ ርቆ እንደ ግድግዳ ቆመ፤ ወደ ዓረባ ባሕር ወደ ጨው ባሕር የሚወርደው ውኃም ፈጽሞ ደረቀ፤ ሕዝቡም በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት ቆሙ።
የእግዚአብሔርንም የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት በዮርዳኖስ መካከል በደረቅ መሬት ጸንተው ቆመው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን ፈጽመው እስኪሻገሩ ድረስ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በደረቅ መሬት ተሻገሩ።

sections.title: Israel shall set up memorial stones.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን ፈጽመው በተሻገሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ከሕዝቡ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሰው፥ ዐሥራ ሁለት ሰዎችን ውሰድ፦
በዮርዳኖስ መካከል የካህናት እግር ከቆመበት ስፍራ ዐሥራ ሁለት ቀላል ድንጋዮችን እንዲያነሡ እዘዛቸው፤ ከእናንተም ጋር ውሰዱአቸው፤ ከዚያም ሌሊት በምታድሩበት ቦታ በየነገዳችሁ ጠብቋቸው።”
ኢያሱም ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሰው፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች የታወቁትን ዐሥራ ሁለት ሰዎች ጠራ።
ኢያሱም አላቸው፥ “በእኔና በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መካከል ዕለፉ፤ እያንዳንዱ ሰው በዐሥራ ሁለቱ ነገደ እስራኤል ቍጥር በትከሻው ላይ አንድ አንድ ድንጋይ ከዚያ ይሸከም።
እነዚህም ምልክት ይሆኑላችኋል፤ ልጅህ ነገ፦ ‘እነዚህ ድንጋዮች ምንድን ናቸው?’ ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ፥ ልጅህን እንዲህ ትለዋለህ፦
አንተ በምድር ሁሉ ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ስንሻገር የዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ስለ ደረቀ ነው፤ እነዚህ ድንጋዮችም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ለዘለዓለም መታሰቢያ ይሆናሉ።”
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢያሱ እንዳዘዛቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ዮርዳኖስን አካትተው በተሻገሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን እንደ አዘዘው በእስራኤል ነገድ ቍጥር ከዮርዳኖስ መካከል ዐሥራ ሁለት ድንጋዮች አንሥተው ወደ ሰፈራቸው ወሰዱ፤ በዚያም አኖሩአቸው።
ኢያሱም የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት እግሮች በቆሙበት ስፍራ በዮርዳኖስ መካከል ሌሎች ዐሥራ ሁለት ድንጋዮችን አቆመ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በዚያ አሉ።
ኢያሱም ለሕዝቡ እንዲነግር፥ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ሁሉ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት በዮርዳኖስ መካከል ቆመው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ፈጥነው ተሻገሩ።
ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አካትተው በተሻገሩ ጊዜ ታቦተ ሕጉ ተሻገረች፤ እነዚያም ድንጋዮች በፊታቸው ተሻገሩ።
ሙሴም እንዳዘዛቸው የሮቤል ልጆች፥ የጋድም ልጆች፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ታጥቀው በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ተሻገሩ።
አርባ ሺህ ያህል ለጦርነት የታጠቁ ሰዎች የኢያሪኮን ሀገር ይወጉ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ተሻገሩ።
በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ፊት ከፍ አደረገው፤ ሙሴንም እንደ ፈሩ በዕድሜው ሁሉ ፈሩት።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የሚሸከሙትን ካህናት ከዮርዳኖስ እንዲወጡ እዘዛቸው።”
ኢያሱም ካህናቱን፥ “ከዮርዳኖስ ውጡ” ብሎ አዘዛቸው።
የእግዚአብሔርንም የቃል ኪዳን ታቦተ ሕግ የተሸከሙ ካህናት ከዮርዳኖስ መካከል በወጡ ጊዜ፥ በእግራቸውም የብስ በረገጡ ጊዜ፥ የዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ተወርውሮ ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ፤ ቀድሞም እንደ ነበረ ሂዶ ዳር እስከ ዳር ሞላ።
ሕዝቡም በመጀመሪያው ወር በዐሥረኛው ቀን ከዮርዳኖስ ወጡ፤ በኢያሪኮም በምሥራቅ በኩል በጌልገላ ሰፈሩ።
ኢያሱም ከዮርዳኖስ ውስጥ የወሰዱአቸውን እነዚያን ዐሥራ ሁለቱን ድንጋዮች በጌልገላ አቆማቸው።
And Jesus spoke unto the children of Israel, saying, “When your children shall ask you, ‘What mean these stones?’ in the time that they inquire of you,
ye shall say unto your children, ‘Israel passed over this Jordan on dry ground;’

For until we had crossed over, our God, the Lord, caused the waters of the sea of Eritrea to be cut off before us; likewise, until we had crossed over, our God, the Lord, cut off the waters of the Jordan before us.
That all the peoples of the earth may know the mighty hand of the Lord, that it is strong, and that ye may fear the Lord your God forever in all His works.”

And it came to pass; that all the kings of the Amorites who were on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, and their hearts melted; neither was there spirit in them any longer because of the children of Israel.

sections.title: And the children of Israel were gathered together in Gilgal.

verses.text: በዚያን ጊዜም እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን፥ “ከሻፎ ድንጋይ የባልጩት መቍረጫ ሠርተህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ዳግመኛ ግረዛቸው” አለው።
ኢያሱም የባልጩት መቍረጫ ሠርቶ የግርዛት ኮረብታ በተባለ ስፍራ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ገረዘ።
ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ የገረዘበት ምክንያት ይህ ነው፤ ከግብፅ የወጡ ወንዶች ተዋጊዎች ሁሉ ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ በመንገድ ላይ በምድረ በዳ ሞቱ፤ የወጡትም ወንዶች ሁሉ ተገርዘው ነበር።
ነገር ግን ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ በመንገድ፥ በምድረ በዳ የተወለዱ ሕዝብ ሁሉ አልተገረዙም ነበርና፥ ኢያሱ እነዚህን ሁሉ ገረዛቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድር ለእኛ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን የማለላቸውን ምድር እንደማያሳያቸው የማለባቸውን፥ ከግብፅ የወጡ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ያልሰሙ፥ እነዚያ ተዋጊዎች ሁሉ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ የእስራኤል ልጆች አርባ ዓመት በመድበራ ምድረ በዳ ይዞሩ ነበር።
ልጆቻቸውን በእነርሱ ፋንታ አስነሣ፤ እነዚህንም ኢያሱ ገረዛቸው፤ በመንገድ ስለተወለዱ አልተገረዙም ነበርና።
በተገረዙም ጊዜ እስኪድኑ ድረስ በሰፈር ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “ዛሬ የግብፅን ተግዳሮት ከእናንተ ላይ አስወግጃለሁ” አለው፤ ስለዚህ የዚያ ስፍራ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ጌልገላ ተብሎ ተጠራ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች በጌልገላ ሰፈሩ፤ ከወሩም በዐሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በኢያሪኮ ምዕራብ ፋሲካን አደረጉ።
ከምድሪቱም ፍሬ ቂጣና አዲስ እህል በዚያው ቀን በሉ።

And in the evening, after the children of Israel had eaten the fruit of the land, the manna ceased; and thereafter the children of Israel did not have manna any longer; but in that year they gathered the fruits of the land of Canaan.

sections.title: And Jesus, having a sword in His hand.

verses.text: And it came to pass, as Joshua was near Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked; and behold, there stood a man over against him with a drawn sword in his hand. And Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, “Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?”
And he said, “Nay; but as captain of the host of the Lord am I now come.” And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, “What saith my lord unto his servant?”
And the captain of the Lord's host said unto Joshua, “Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy.” And Joshua did so.

sections.title: The Fall of the Walls of Jericho

verses.text: ኢያሪኮም በግንብ ታጥራ ተዘግታ ነበር፤ ወደ እርስዋ የሚገባ፥ ከእርስዋም የሚወጣ አልነበረም።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን አለው፥ “እነሆ፥ ኢያሪኮንና ንጉሥዋን ጽኑዓን፥ ኀያላንዋንም በእጅህ ሰጥቼአለሁ።
አንተም ተዋጊዎችን ሁሉ በዙሪያው አሰልፋቸው። ተዋጊዎቻችሁም ሁሉ በከተማዪቱ ዙሪያ አንድ ጊዜ ይዙሩ፤ እንዲሁም ስድስት ቀን አድርጉ።
ሰባትም ካህናት ሰባት ቀንደ መለከት በታቦቱ ፊት ይያዙ፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ ዙሩ፤ ካህናቱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ይንፉ።
ቀንደ መለከቱም ባለማቋረጥ ሲነፋ፥ የመለከቱን ድምፅ ስትሰሙ፥ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ታላቅ ጩኸት ይጩኹ፤ የከተማዪቱም ቅጥር ይወድቃል፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ፊት ለፊት እየሮጠ ይገባባታል።”
የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ ካህናቱን ጠርቶ፥ “የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ተሸከሙ፤ ሰባትም ካህናት ሰባት ቀንደ መለከት ወስደው በእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ፊት ይሂዱ” አላቸው።
ሕዝቡንም፥ “ሂዱ፤ ከተማዪቱንም ዙሩ፤ ተዋጊዎችም ከጦር መሣሪያዎቻቸው ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ፊት ይሂዱ ብላችሁ እዘዙአቸው” አላቸው።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ይሄዱ ዘንድ ኢያሱ እንደ ነገራቸው ሰባቱ ካህናት የተቀደሱ ሰባቱን ቀንደ መለከት ይዘው ሄዱ፤ በሄዱም ጊዜ አሰምተው በምልክት ነፉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም የሕጉ ታቦት ትከተላቸው ነበር።
ሰልፈኞችም ፊት ፊት ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ካህናቱም ነጋሪት ይመቱ ነበር፤ ከታቦቱ በኋላ ይከተሉ የነበሩትም ቀንደ መለከቱን እየነፉ ይሄዱ ነበር።
ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን፦ እንዳይጮኹ ማንም ድምፃቸውን እንዳይሰማ፥ እንዲጮኹ እስኪያዛቸውም ድረስ ከአፋቸው ቃል እንዳይወጣ አዘዛቸው።
የእግዚአብሔርም የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ሄደች፤ ከተማዪቱንም ዞረች፤ ወደ ሰፈርም ተመልሳ በዚያ አደረች።
ኢያሱም በማግሥቱ ማለዳ ተነሣ፤ ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን የሕጉን ታቦት ተሸከሙ።
ሰባቱም ካህናት ሰባቱን ቀንደ መለከት ይዘው በእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ፊት ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ቀንደ መለከቱንም ይነፉ ነበር፤ ተዋጊዎችም በፊታቸው ይሄዱ ነበር፤ የቀሩትም ሕዝብ ከእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በኋላ ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ካህናቱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ይነፉ ነበር።
በሁለተኛውም ቀን የቀረው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከተማዪቱን አንድ ጊዜ ዞረው ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሱ፤ ስድስት ቀንም እንዲህ አደረጉ።
በሰባተኛውም ቀን በነጋ ጊዜ ማልደው ተነሡ፤ እንደዚህም ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ ዞሩ፤ በዚያም ቀን ብቻ ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ ዞሩ።
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ በዞሩና ካህናቱ ቀንደ መለከቱን በነፉ ጊዜ፤ ኢያሱ ለእስራኤል ልጆች አለ፥ “እግዚአብሔር ከተማዪቱን ሰጥቶአችኋልና ጩኹ።
ከተማዪቱም በእርስዋም ያለው ሁሉ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር እርም ይሆናሉ፤ የላክናቸውን መልእክተኞች ስለ ሸሸገች ዘማዊቱ ረዓብ፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር በቤቷ ውስጥ ያሉ ሁሉ ብቻ በሕይወት ይኖራሉ።
እናንተ ግን እርም ብለን ከተውነው እንዳትወስዱ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ከእርሱም ተመኝታችሁ አትውሰዱ፤ ብትወስዱ ግን የእስራኤልን ሰፈር የተረገመች ታደርጓታላችሁ፤ እኛንም ታጠፉናላችሁ።
ነገር ግን ብርና ወርቅ ሁሉ፥ የናስና የብረትም ዕቃ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሁን፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ግምጃ ቤት ይግባ።”
ሕዝቡም ጮኹ፥ ካህናቱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ነፉ፤ ሕዝቡም የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ በሰሙ ጊዜ ታላቅ ጩኸት ጮኹ፤ ቅጥሩም ወደቀ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ከተማዪቱ ገቡ፤ ሁሉም ወደ ፊታቸው ወደ ከተማዪቱ ሮጡ፤ ከተማዪቱንም እጅ አደረጉ።
And Jesus destroyed all that were in the city, both men and women, both young and old, both cattle and sheep, and horses, with the sword; He utterly consumed them.
And Jesus commanded the two men who had been sent, saying, "Go into the house of the harlot; and bring out from there the woman and all that she has, as you have sworn to her."

And those two men who had been sent entered the house of the harlot and brought out Rahab, her father and her mother, and her brothers, and all that she had, and they brought out all her relatives; and they set them outside the camp of Israel.
And they burned the city with fire, and all that was in it; but the silver and the gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.
And Joshua sent the spies to Jericho, and they went to the house of Rahab, and they brought out all her family; and she dwelt in the midst of Israel until this day.
And on that day, Jesus said, "Cursed be the man who rises up to build this city Jericho; he shall lay its foundation with his firstborn, and with his youngest son shall he set up its gates."
And the Lord was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the earth.

sections.title: The sin of Achan.

verses.text: And the children of Israel committed a great sin, for they were led astray; and there was a man of the tribe of Judah, whose name was Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, and he took of the accursed thing; and the anger of the Lord was kindled against the children of Israel.
And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, eastward; and he spake unto them, saying, “Go up and view the country.” And the men went up and viewed Ai.

And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, “Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labor thither; for they are but few.”
So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men; and they fled before the men of Ai.

And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men; for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down; wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the Lord until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

And Joshua said, “Alas, O Lord God! Wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? Would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!”
O Lord! What shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies?
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth; and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?
And the Lord said unto Joshua, “Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?”
ሕዝቡ በድለዋል፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር የገባሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አፍርሰዋል፤ እርም ከሆነውም ነገር ሰርቀው ወሰዱ፤ በዕቃቸውም ውስጥ ሸሸጉት።
ስለዚህም የእስራኤል ልጆች በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት መቆም አይችሉም፤ የተረገሙ ስለሆኑ በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት ይሸሻሉ፤ እርም የሆነውንም ነገር ከመካከላችሁ ካላጠፋችሁ ከዚህ በኋላ ከእናንተ ጋር አልሆንም።
ተነሣና ሕዝቡን ቀድስ እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ‘እስራኤል ሆይ! እርም የሆነ ነገር በመካከልህ አለ፤ እርምም የሆነውን ነገር ከመካከላችሁ እስክታጠፉ ድረስ በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት መቆም አትችሉም’ ብሎ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና እስከ ነገ ራሳችሁን አንጹ።
ነገም በየነገዳችሁ ትቀርባላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚለየው ነገድ በየወገኖቹ ይቀርባል፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚለየው ወገን በየቤተ ሰቦቹ ይቀርባል፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚለየው ቤተ ሰብ በየሰዉ ይቀርባል።
ምልክት የታየበት ሰው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን አፍርሶአልና፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ በደል አድርጎአልና፥ እርሱና ያለው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ።”
ኢያሱም ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ እስራኤልንም በየነገዶቻቸው ሰበሰባቸው፤ በይሁዳም ነገድ ላይ ምልክት ታየ፤
የይሁዳም ወገኖች ተለዩ፤ በዛራም ወገን ምልክት ታየ፤ የዛራም ወገን በየቤተ ሰቡ ተለየ፤
በዘንበሪም ወገን ምልክት ታየ፤ የዘንበሪም ቤተ ሰብ እያንዳንዱ ተለየ፤ ከይሁዳም ወገን በሆነ በከርሚ ልጅ በዘንበሪ ልጅ በዛራ ልጅ በአካን ላይ ምልክት ታየ።
ኢያሱም አካንን፥ “ልጄ ሆይ! ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ስጥ፤ ለእርሱም ተናዘዝ፤ ያደረግኸውንም ንገረኝ፤ አትሸሽገኝም” አለው።
አካንም መልሶ ኢያሱን፥ “በእውነት በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በድያለሁ፤ እንዲህና እንዲህም አድርጌአለሁ።
በዘረፋ መካከል አንድ ያማረ ካባ፥ ሁለት መቶ ሰቅል ብር፥ ሚዛኑም አምሳ ሰቅል የሆነ ወርቅ አይቼ ተመኘኋቸው፤ ወሰድኋቸውም፤ እነሆም በድንኳኔ ውስጥ በመሬት ተሸሽገዋል፤ ብሩም ከሁሉ በታች ነው” አለው።
ኢያሱም መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤ ወደ ሰፈርም ወደ ድንኳኑ ሮጡ፤ እነሆም እርሱ በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ተደብቆ፥ ብሩም በበታቹ ነበረ።
ከድንኳኑም ውስጥ አውጥተው ወደ ኢያሱና ወደ እስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ አመጡት፤ በእግዚአብሔርምፊት አኖሩት።
ኢያሱም የዛራን ልጅ አካንን፥ ብሩንም፥ ልብሱንም፥ ልሳነ ወርቁንም ወደ አኮር ሸለቆ ወሰዳቸው፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቹንም፥ በሬዎቹንም፥ አህያዎቹንም፥ በጎቹንም፥ ድንኳኑንም፥ ንብረቱንም ሁሉ ወደ ዔሜቃኮር ወሰደ።
ኢያሱም፥ “ለምን አጠፋኸን? ዛሬ እንዳጠፋኸን እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ ያጥፋህ” አለው፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በድንጋይ ወገሩት፤ በእሳትም አቃጠሉት፤ በድንጋይም ወገሩአቸው።
በላዩም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያለ ታላቅ የድንጋይ ክምር ከመሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከቍጣው መቅሠፍት ተመለሰ። ስለዚህም የዚያ ስፍራ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዔሜቃኮር ተብሎ ተጠራ።

sections.title: The Lamentation of the City of Gai.

verses.text: And the Lord said to Joshua, “Fear not; do not be dismayed; take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai; behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, and the city, and the land.”
“As you have done to Jericho and its king, so you shall do to Ai and its king; only its spoil and its cattle you shall take as plunder for yourselves; lay an ambush for the city behind it,” he said.
And Joshua and all the people of war arose to go up to Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand mighty men of valor and sent them out by night.
And he commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city; do not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.”
I and all the people who are with me will approach the city; and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we shall flee before them.
And they will come out after us, till we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They are fleeing before us as at the first.’ So we will flee before them.
Then you shall rise from your ambush and seize the city; for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.
And it shall be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire; according to the commandment of the Lord you shall do. Behold, I have commanded you.”
Joshua therefore sent them forth; and they went to lie in ambush and stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai; but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
And Joshua arose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord; and the people of Israel went up before them to Ai.
ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ተዋጊዎች ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወጥተው ቀረቡ፤ ወደ ከተማዪቱም ፊት ደረሱ፤ በጋይም በምሥራቅ በኩል ሰፈሩ፤ በእነርሱና በጋይም መካከል ሸለቆ ነበረ።
ኢያሱም አምስት ሺህ ሰዎችን ወስዶ በቤቴልና በጋይ መካከል በጋይ ባሕር በኩል ይከብቡ ዘንድ አስቀመጣቸው።
ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሠራዊቶቻቸውን በከተማው መስዕ በኩል አኖሩ፤ ዳርቻውም እስከ ከተማው ባሕር ድረስ ነው፤ ኢያሱም በዚያች ሌሊት ወደ ሸለቆው መካከል ሄደ።
የጋይም ንጉሥ በሰማ ጊዜ ፈጥኖ ሄደ። የከተማዪቱም ሰዎች ወጡ፤ እርሱና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በተወሰነው ጊዜ በዓረባ ፊት ባለው አንድ ስፍራ እስራኤልን በጦርነት ተቀበሉአቸው፤ እርሱ ግን ከከተማዪቱ በስተኋላ እንደ ተደበቁ አያውቅም ነበር።
በደረሱባቸውም ጊዜ ኢያሱና እስራኤል ሁሉ ከፊታቸው አፈገፈጉ፤ በምድረ በዳው መንገድም ሸሹ።
የሀገሪቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ ተጠሩ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ተከትለው አሳደዱአቸው፤ ከከተማዪቱም እንዲርቁ አደረጓቸው።
በጋይና በቤቴልም ውስጥ እስራኤልን ለማሳደድ ያልወጣ ሰው አልነበረም፤ ከተማዪቱንም ከፍተው ተዉ፤ እስራኤልንም አሳደዱት።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “ጋይን በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁና በእጅህ ያለውን ጦር በላይዋ ዘርጋ፤ ከተማዪቱንም የከበቡአት ፈጥነው ከስፍራቸው ይነሣሉ” አለው፤ ኢያሱም በከተማዋ ላይ በእጁ ያለውን ጦር ዘረጋ።
የተደበቁትም ፈጥነው ከስፍራቸው ተነሡ፤ ኢያሱም እጁን በዘረጋ ጊዜ ወጡ፤ ወደ ከተማዋም ገብተው ያዙአት፤ ፈጥነውም በእሳት አቃጠሉአት።
የጋይም ሰዎች ወደ ኋላቸው ዞረው በተመለከቱ ጊዜ የከተማዪቱ ጢስ ወደ ሰማይ ሲወጣ አዩ፤ ወዲህና ወዲያ መሸሽ አልቻሉም፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳም የሸሹ ሕዝብ በሚያሳድዱአቸው ላይ ተመለሱ።
And it came to pass that Joshua, and all Israel, took the city which they had besieged, and when they beheld the smoke of the city ascending to heaven, they turned back and smote the men of Ai.
And they went forth from the city and took possession; and among the hosts of the children of Israel, they were smitten; and they were as one man, not one of them turned back or fled.
And the king of Ai was brought unto Joshua alive.

And the children of Israel followed after them, and when they had smitten the men of Ai, they turned back and smote them with the edge of the sword, and Joshua returned unto Ai and destroyed it with the sword.
And in that day, all who fell, both men and women, of the men of Ai were twelve thousand souls.
And Joshua did not withdraw his hand, which he had stretched out with the sword, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
But the Lord commanded Joshua that the city should be devoted to destruction, and all that was therein, for the children of Israel were to be set apart for themselves.
And Joshua burned the city with fire; it became a heap forever; it shall not be inhabited unto this day.

And the king of Ai was hanged upon a tree until evening; and as the sun went down, Joshua commanded that his body be taken down from the tree and cast at the entrance of the city, and raised a great heap of stones upon it, which remains unto this day.

sections.title: The Law of Moses was given upon Mount Horeb.

verses.text: የዚያ ጊዜም ኢያሱ በጌባል ተራራ ላይ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያን ሠራ።
የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዳዘዘ፥ በሙሴም ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው፥ መሠዊያው ካልተወቀረና ብረት ካልነካው ድንጋይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፤ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት ሠዋ።
ኢያሱም በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ፊት በድንጋዮቹ ላይ ሙሴ የጻፈውን ይህን ሁለተኛውን ሕግ በድንጋዮች ላይ ጻፈ።

የእስራኤልንም ሕዝብ አስቀድሞ ይባርኩአቸው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ፥ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቻቸውም፥ ጸሓፊዎቻቸውም፥ ፈራጆቻቸውም፥ የሀገሩ ልጆችም፥ መጻተኞችም እኩሌቶቹ በገሪዛን ተራራ አጠገብ፥ እኩሌቶቹም በጌባል ተራራ አጠገብ ሆነው፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦተ ሕግ በተሸከሙት በሌዋውያን ካህናት ፊት ለፊት፥ በታቦቱም ፊት በግራና በቀኝ ቆመው ነበር።
ከዚህም በኋላ ኢያሱ በሙሴ ሕግ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ፥ የሕጉን ቃሎች ሁሉ በረከቱንና ርግማኑን አነበበ።
ኢያሱም በእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ፥ በወንዶቹም፥ በሴቶቹም፥ በሕፃናቱም፥ በመካከላቸውም በሚኖሩት መጻተኞች ፊት ሙሴ ካዘዘው ያላነበበውና ያላሰማው ቃል የለም።

sections.title: The men of Gibeon did not allow him to be deceived.

verses.text: And thus it came to pass; all the kings who were on the other side of the Jordan in the hill country and in the lowland, and along the great sea toward Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, when they heard this,
they gathered together as one to fight against Joshua and all Israel.
But the inhabitants of Gibeon, when they heard what the Lord had done to Jericho and to Ai,
they also acted cunningly and went and prepared provisions for themselves; they took old sacks on their donkeys, and wineskins, old and torn and mended;
and they put worn-out, patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments; and all the bread of their provision was dry and moldy.
And they went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country; now therefore make a covenant with us.”
And the children of Israel said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you dwell among us; so how can we make a covenant with you?”
But they said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” And Joshua said to them, “Who are you, and where do you come from?”
So they said to him, “From a very distant country your servants have come, because of the name of the Lord your God; for we have heard of His fame, and all that He did in Egypt,
and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth and Edrei.”
O our rulers and all the people of our land: Take hold of the covenant for the way; go forth to meet them; for we are your servants; even now, make a covenant with us, as they have said.
And when we arose to come unto you on that day, this bread we took from our house for the way; and behold, now it is dry; it has become moldy.
And these new wineskins were filled; behold, they have burst; and our way is greatly hindered, for these our garments and our shoes have become torn.
And the rulers took of their provisions; yet they did not ask counsel of the Lord.
And Joshua made peace with them, and he made a covenant with them to let them live; and the rulers of the congregation swore unto them.
And it came to pass, when they had made a covenant with them, that they heard afterward that they were their neighbors and that they dwelt among them.
And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day; now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
And the rulers of the congregation swore unto them by the Lord God of Israel; and they did not smite them; and the congregation murmured against the rulers.
And all the rulers said unto the congregation, "We have sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel; now therefore we may not touch them."
And concerning our oath to them, let us not bring upon ourselves the wrath of destruction; let us let them live; and so they said unto them.
And the leaders said, "You shall cut down trees for the community, and you shall provide water for your sustenance." Thus did the leaders command them.
And Jesus, turning to them, said, "If you dwell among us and say, 'We are indeed very far from you,' why do you not speak to us?"
"Now you are those who have been made to understand; for me and for my God, a tree shall not perish, nor shall a servant who is pure of water be lost from you," they said.

They replied to Jesus, "We, your servants, shall give the land to you, so that all who dwell therein may be removed from before you, as your God, the Lord, commanded your servant Moses; truly we have heard; therefore, we are exceedingly afraid for our souls, and we have done this matter."
"Now behold, we are in your hands; do unto us as it pleases you and as it seems good to you," they said.
And Jesus did likewise; he took the hand of the children of Israel and did not harm them.

And on that day, Jesus made for them trees for the community and for the Lord, as offerings of wood and pure water. Therefore, those who entered made offerings for the community and for the Lord, and the Lord has had trees and pure water for the chosen place until this day.

sections.title: And the Amorites were vanquished in Israel.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ አዶኒቤዜቅ ኢያሱ ጋይን እንደ ያዘ፥ ፈጽሞም እንዳጠፋት፥ በኢያሪኮና በንጉሥዋም ያደረገውን እንዲሁ በጋይና በንጉሥዋም እንዳደረገ፥ የገባዖንም ሰዎች ከኢያሱና ከእስራኤል ጋር ሰላም እንዳደረጉ፥ በመካከላቸውም እንደ ሆኑ በሰማ ጊዜ፥
ገባዖን ከመንግሥታት ከተሞች እንደ አንዲቱ ታላቅ ከተማ ስለሆነች፥ ከጋይም ስለ በለጠች፥ ሰዎችዋም ሁሉ ኀያላን ስለ ነበሩ እጅግ ፈራ።
ስለዚህም የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ አዶኒቤዜቅ ወደ ኬብሮን ንጉሥ ወደ ኤላም፥ ወደ የርሙት ንጉሥም ወደ ፊዶን፥ ወደ ለኪስ ንጉሥም ወደ ኤፍታ፥ ወደ አዶላም ንጉሥም ወደ ዳቤር ልኮ፥
“ወደ እኔ ኑ፤ ከኢያሱና ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ጋር ሰላም አድርገዋልና ገባዖንን ለመውጋት አግዙኝ” አለ።
አምስቱም የኢያቡሴዎን ነገሥት፥ የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ የኬብሮን ንጉሥ፥ የየርሙት ንጉሥ፥ የላኪስ ንጉሥ፥ የአዶላም ንጉሥ፥ ከሠራዊቶቻቸው ሁሉ ጋር ተሰብስበው ወጡ፤ ከገባዖንም ጋር ሊጋጠሙ ከበቡአት።
የገባዖንም ሰዎች ኢያሱ ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ ጌልገላ ልከው፥ “ባሪያዎችህን ለመርዳት እጅህን አትመልስ፤ በተራራማው ሀገር የሚኖሩ የአሞሬዎናውያን ነገሥት ሁሉ ተሰብስበውብናልና ፈጥነህ ወደ እኛ ውጣ፤ አድነንም፤ ርዳንም፤” አሉት።
ኢያሱም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ተዋጊዎች ሁሉ፥ ጽኑዓን ኀያላኑም ሁሉ ከጌልጌላ ወጡ።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁና አትፍራቸው፤ ከእነርሱም አንድ ሰው በፊትህ የሚተርፍ የለም፤” አለው።
ኢያሱም ከጌልገላ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ገሥግሦ በድንገት ደረሰባቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ፊት አስደነገጣቸው፤ በገባዖንም ታላቅ መምታት መታቸው።

And as they fled from before the children of Israel, while they were descending from Beth-horon, the Lord cast down upon them a great hailstone from heaven, and they died; more were those who died by the hailstone than those whom the children of Israel had slain with the sword.
At that time, the Lord delivered the Amorites into the hand of the children of Israel; and he spoke to the Lord, saying, "Sun, stand still upon Gibeon; and moon, in the valley of Aijalon."

And the Lord caused their enemies to be defeated until the sun and the moon stood still in their places. Behold, this is written in this book at that time. The sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and did not hasten to go down for about a whole day.
For the Lord fought for Israel, and there was no day like that day before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man.
And Joshua, and all Israel with him, returned unto the camp at Gilgal.

sections.title: And Jesus smote the five kings of the Amorites as He had commanded.

verses.text: እነዚህም አምስት ነገሥት ሸሽተው በመቄዳ ዋሻ ተሸሸጉ።
ለኢያሱም “አምስቱ ነገሥት በመቄዳ ዋሻ ተሸሽገው ተገኙ፤” ብለው ነገሩት።
ኢያሱም እንዲህ አለ፥ “ወደ ዋሻው አፍ ታላላቅ ድንጋይ አንከባልላችሁ፥ ይጠብቋቸው ዘንድ ሰዎችን በዚያ አኑሩ፤
እናንተ ግን አትዘግዩ፤ ጠላቶቻችሁንም እስከ መጨረሻው ተከታትላችሁ ያዙአቸው፤ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋልና ወደ ከተሞቻቸው እንዳይገቡ ከልክሉአቸው፤” አለ።
እስኪጠፉም ድረስ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች በታላቅ መምታት መምታታቸውን በፈጸሙ ጊዜ፥ ከእነርሱም ያመለጡት ወደ ተመሸገ ከተማ በገቡ ጊዜ፥
ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ኢያሱ ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ መቄዳ በደኅና ተመለሱ፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ምላሱን ማንቀሳቀስ የደፈረ ማንም ሰው የለም።
ኢያሱም፥ “የዋሻውን አፍ ክፈቱ፤ እነዚያንም አምስት ነገሥት ከዋሻው ወደ እኔ አውጡአቸው” አለ።
እንዲህም አደረጉ፤ አምስቱንም ነገሥት፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን ንጉሥ፥ የኬብሮንንም ንጉሥ፥ የየርሙትንም ንጉሥ፥ የላኪስንም ንጉሥ፥ የአዶላምንም ንጉሥ ከዋሻው ወደ እርሱ አወጡአቸው።
እነዚያንም ነገሥት ወደ ኢያሱ ባመጡአቸው ጊዜ ኢያሱ የእስራኤልን ሰዎች ሁሉ ጠራ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የሄዱትን የተዋጊዎችን አለቆች “ቅረቡ፤ በእነዚህም ነገሥት አንገት ላይ እግራችሁን አኑሩ” አላቸው። ቀረቡም በአንገታቸውም ላይ እግራቸውን አኖሩ።
ኢያሱም፥ “በምትወጉአቸው በጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ ላይ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ያደርጋልና አትፍሩ፤ አትደንግጡ፤ ጽኑ፤ አይዞአችሁ” አላቸው።
And after this, they were slain; and upon the five trees, they were hanged; until evening, they remained hanging upon the trees.

And when the sun was about to set, he commanded; and they descended from the trees; and they hastened and took refuge in the place where they were; even unto this day, a great stone has been placed at the mouth of the refuge.

sections.title: And Jesus, having taken possession of other cities, said unto them.

verses.text: And on that day, they took the city of Makedah; and they smote her and her king with the sword, and they utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; they left not a single one remaining; as they did to the king of Jericho, so they did to the king of Makedah.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, passed from Makedah unto Libnah; and they fought against Libnah.

And the Lord delivered her and her king into the hand of Israel; and they smote her and all the souls that were therein with the sword; they left not a single one remaining; as they did to the king of Jericho, so they did to the king of Libnah.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, passed from Libnah unto Lachish; and they encamped against her and fought against her.
And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel; and they took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, as they had done to Libnah.
Then the king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people with the sword, leaving not a single one remaining.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, passed from Lachish unto Eglon; and they encamped against her and fought against her.

And the Lord delivered her into the hand of Israel; and on that day they took her, and smote her with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein, as they had done to Lachish.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, went from Eglon unto Hebron; and they fought against her.

And they smote her and her king, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein with the sword; they left not a single one remaining, as they had done to Eglon; they utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, returned to Debir; and they went up.

And they took her, and her king, and all her cities; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; there was not a single one left. Thus did he to Debir and to her king, as he had done to Hebron and to her king.

Likewise, Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and all their kings; he left not a single one remaining; he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
And Joshua smote from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
And the Lord God of Israel delivered all these kings into the hand of Israel, and they smote them, and chased them, and took their land at one time.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, returned to the camp at Gilgal.

sections.title: And Jesus triumphed over Jabez and other kings.

verses.text: And it came to pass that when King Jabin of Hazor heard this, he sent to Jobab, King of Madon, and to the King of Shimron, and to the King of Achshaph,
in the mountains, in the region of the Chinnereth, and in the lowland, and in the heights of the Arabah, and to the kings who were in the hill country,

and to the kings who were in the eastern sea, and to the Canaanites, and to the Amorites, and to the Hittites, and to the Perizzites, and to the kings who were in the hill country, and to the Jebusites, and to the kings who were in the lowland, and to the Hivites,
they went out with their armies, all of them, in great numbers like the sand that is on the seashore; and there were many horses and chariots.
And all these kings came together and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
And the Lord said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for tomorrow at this time I will deliver them all slain before Israel; you shall hamstring their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.”
So Joshua and all the people of war with him came against them suddenly by the waters of Merom, and fell upon them.

And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who defeated them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpeh eastward; they struck them until no survivor was left.
And Joshua did to them as the Lord had said; he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor formerly was the head of all those kingdoms.
And they killed all the people who were in her, with the sword; they did not spare any that breathed, but they utterly destroyed all; and they burned Assyria with fire.
And the servant of the Lord, Moses, commanded, and Joshua struck all these kings and their cities with the sword; he utterly destroyed them.
Except for the ones that were burned, Israel did not destroy any of the other cities that were in their regions.

And the children of Israel took all these cities as a spoil, and they reserved the livestock for themselves; but all the people they struck with the sword until they had destroyed them; they did not spare any that breathed.
And the Lord commanded His servant Moses, and so Moses commanded Joshua; and Joshua did likewise; and the Lord did not leave anything that He had commanded Moses.

sections.title: And Jesus took other vessels as He had.

verses.text: ኢያሱም ያን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ተራራማውን፥ ደቡቡንም ሁሉ፥ የጎሶምንም ምድር ሁሉ ፥ ሜዳውንም፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ያለውንም፥ የእስራኤልንም ተራራማውንና ቆላውን ያዘ፤
እስከ ሴይርም ከሚያወጣው ከኤኬል ተራራ ጀምሮ ከአርሞንዔም ተራራ በታች እስከ ሊባኖስ ሜዳና እስከ በላጋድ ድረስ፤ ንጉሦቻቸውን ሁሉ ይዞ መታቸው፤ ገደላቸውም።
ኢያሱም ብዙ ዘመን ከእነዚሁ ነገሥታት ሁሉ ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር።
በገባዖን ከሚኖሩ ከኤዎናውያን በቀር፤ እስራኤል ያልያዙት ከተማ አልነበረም፥ ሁሉን በጦርነት ያዙ።
እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ፥ ያጠፉአቸው ዘንድ እንዳይራሩላቸው ፈጽመው እንዲያጠፉአቸው፥ ከእስራኤል ጋር ይጋጠሙ ዘንድ ልባቸውን እንዲያደነድኑ እግዚአብሔር ልባቸውን አጸና።
በዚያ ጊዜም ኢያሱ ሄደ፤ በተራራማውም ሀገር የሚኖሩ ኤናቃውያንን ከኬብሮንና ከዳቤር፥ ከአናቦትም፥ ከእስራኤልም ተራራ ሁሉ፥ ከይሁዳም ተራራ ሁሉ አጠፋቸው፤ ኢያሱም ከከተሞቻቸው ጋር ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው።
በጋዛ፥ በጌትም፥ በአዛጦንም ከቀሩት በቀር በእስራኤል መካከል ከኤናቃውያን ማንንም አላስቀረም።
እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ኢያሱ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ያዘ፤ ኢያሱም ለእስራኤል እንደ ክፍላቸው በየነገዳቸው ርስት አድርጎ ምድሪቱን ሰጣቸው፤ ምድሪቱም ከጦርነት ዐረፈች።

sections.title: Moses did great deeds for the kings.

verses.text: The children of Israel who perished, from the valley of Arnon to the mountain of Hermon, all the land of the Arabah which lies to the east, even to the land of their possession which they inherited, these are the kingdoms of the earth.
In Heshbon, which is situated by the valley of Arnon, from the midst of the valley, even to the border of the children of Ammon, as far as the river Jabbok, and the region of Gilead.

To the east, the land of the Arabah extends to the Sea of Chinnereth, along the way of Assemoth, as far as the Sea of Arabah and the Sea of Salt, and to the south, the land which lies beneath the mountain of Pisgah, is the possession of the king of the Amorites, Sihon.
From the side of the Reubenites, which is situated in Astaroth and in Edrei.
The mountain of Hermon, all of Bashan, as far as Gergesh and to the border of the region of Gilead, even to Heshbon, the king of the Amorites, as far as the border of Sihon, the king of Bashan.

The servant of the Lord, Moses, and the children of Israel smote them; and the servant of the Lord, Moses, gave inheritance to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, the land according to their divisions.

sections.title: Jesus, the King who has granted them victory.

verses.text: These are the kings of the Canaanites who were slain by the children of Israel and by Joshua in the mountains, in the lowland, in the Jordan Valley, and in the region of the Sea of Seir. And Joshua gave this land to the tribes of Israel as a possession.

They cast down their inheritance in the mountains and in the plains, in the Arabah, in the Asedoth, in the Negev, in the Ketron and in the Amorites, in the Canaanites and in the Perizzites, in the Jebusites and in the Hivites.
The king of Jericho, the king of the city that is near Bethel,
The king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
The king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish,
The king of Elam, the king of Gezer,
The king of Debir, the king of Gath,
The king of Hermon, the king of Arad,
The king of Libnah, the king of Adullam,
The king of Makeda,
The king of the Ephod,
The king of Opher,
The king of the Afekites, the king of Assur,
The king of Simeon, the king of Memeroth,
The king of Azif, the king of Qades,
The king of Zeqaq, the king of Mardoth, the king of Deqom who dwelt in Carmel,
The king of Edor who is in the region of Fenadr, the king of Hagi who is in the region of Galia, the king of Tirsa,
These are all the kings, thirty and nine in number.

sections.title: The lands that have not yet been possessed.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Joshua, saying, “Behold, the time has passed; much land remains yet to be possessed;
This is the land that remaineth: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites, and all the land of the Canaanites,

From the wilderness that is before Egypt, even unto the five lords of the Philistines; to Gaza, to Ashdod, to Ashkelon, to Ekron, and unto the Avites; and also to the land of the Canaanites, as far as the border of the Sidonians,
From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, even unto the border of the Amorites, and unto the border of the great sea,
And all the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon toward the east, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon unto the entering in of Hamath;

And all the inhabitants of the mountainous region, from Lebanon even unto Misrephoth-maim, all the Sidonians; them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh; from Jordan, by the way of the great sea, shall ye divide it unto them; and their border shall be toward the great sea.”

sections.title: The land that is to the east of the Jordan.

verses.text: And Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, as he had commanded them, their inheritance, which was on the east side of the Jordan, even the land of Gilead, as he had given them.
From the valley of Arnon, which is at the edge of Aroer, and from the city that is in the midst of the valley, even to all the plain that extends as far as Dibon,
And all the cities of the plain, which are in Heshbon, and all the kingdom of Sihon, which is the king of the Amorites, even to the border of the children of Ammon,
And Gilead, and all the region of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan, even to Salcah,
And all the kingdom of Og, which was in Bashan, which was called the land of giants; he was left of the remnant of the giants; these Moses smote, and drove them out.
But the children of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites, nor the inhabitants of the land of Canaan; but to this day Geshur and Maachath dwell among Israel.
For the tribe of Levi, however, no inheritance was given; the Lord God of Israel is their inheritance, as He said to them. Thus Moses distributed to the children of Israel, as the Lord commanded.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Reuben.

verses.text: ሙሴም ለሮቤል ነገድ በየወገናቸው ርስትን ሰጣቸው።
ድንበራቸውም በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ በሸለቆው መካከል ያለችው ከተማ፥ ሜሶርም ሁሉ፥
ሐሴቦን፥ በሜሶርም ያሉት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ዲቦን፥ ባሞትበዐል፥ ቤትበአልምዖን፥
ባሳን፥ ቀዲሞት፥ ሜፍዓ፥
ቂርያታይም፥ ሴባማ፥ ሲራዳት፥ በሸለቆውም ተራራ ያለችው ሲዮን፥
ቤተ ፌጎር፥ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለው ምድር፥ ቤትሲሞት፥
የሚሶር ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ በሐሴቦንም የነገሠው የአሞሬዎናውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን መንግሥት ሁሉ ነበረ፤ ሙሴም እርሱንና በምድሪቱ የተቀመጡትን የሴዎንን መሳፍንት፥ የምድያምን አለቆች ኤዊን፥ ሮቦቅን፥ ሱርን፥ ኡርን፥ ሮቤን በሲዮን የሚኖሩትንም ገደላቸው።
ሟርተኛውን የቢዖርን ልጅ በለዓምንም በአንድነት በሰይፍ ገደሉት።
የሮቤልም ልጆች ድንበር የዮርዳኖስ ወንዝና ዳርቻው ነበረ። የሮቤል ልጆች ርስት ከተሞቻቸውም መንደሮቻቸውም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

sections.title: The inheritance given to Gad.

verses.text: And Moses gave to Gad, and to the children of Gad, according to their families, their inheritance.
And their border was from Jazer and all the cities of Gilead, and the land of the children of Ammon, even half of the land of the children of Ammon, as far as Aroer.
From Heshbon unto Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from Mahanaim unto Debir.

In the valley, and the city of Heshbon, and the city of Ramath, and Succoth, and Zaphon, which is the kingdom of Sihon, the king of Heshbon. And the border was Jordan, and the region eastward, even unto the Sea of Chinnereth, and the region of the river.

The inheritance of the children of Gad was their cities and their villages, according to their families. And before their enemies, they turned their backs and fled; their villages and their cities were established according to their tribes.

sections.title: To Manasseh was given a heritage that was equal.

verses.text: And Moses gave to the tribe of Manasseh, according to their families, their inheritance;

Their border began at Mahanaim, all the kingdom of Og which is in Bashan, all the region of Bashan, and all the cities of the kingdom of Og, which were in Bashan, sixty cities, which are called the cities of Gilead;

And the cities of the kingdom of Og which were in Bashan, were Ashtaroth and Edrei. These were for the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh; for the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were these their inheritances according to their families.
Moses, in the region of the east, near Jericho, on the plain of Moab, gave these inheritances.

sections.title: The division of the inheritance that is on the other side of the Jordan.

verses.text: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከነዓን ምድር የወረሱት ካህኑ አልዓዛርና የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገድ የአባቶቻቸው አለቆች ያወረሱአቸው ርስት ይህ ነው።
እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ ለዘጠኙ ነገድና ለእኩሌታው በየርስታቸው በዕጣ አከፋፈሉአቸው።
ለሁለቱ ነገድና ለእኩሌታው ነገድ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሙሴ ርስት ሰጥቶ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በመካከላቸው ለሌዋውያን ርስት አልሰጣቸውም።
የዮሴፍ ልጆች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ሁለት ነገዶች ነበሩ፤ ለሌዋውያንም ከሚቀመጡባቸው ከተሞች ለእንስሶቻቸው ከሚሆን ማሰማሪያቸውና ከእንስሶቻቸውም በቀር በምድሩ ውስጥ ድርሻ አልሰጡአቸውም።
እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉ፤ ምድሪቱንም ተካፈሉ።

sections.title: Hebron was given to Caleb as it had been promised.

verses.text: የይሁዳም ልጆች በጌልገላ ወደ ኢያሱ ቀረቡ፤ ቄኔዛዊውም የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ አለው፥ “ለአምላክ ሰው ለሙሴ ስለ እኔና ስለ አንተ እግዚአብሔር በቃዴስ በርኔ የተናገረውን ቃል ታውቃለህ።
የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ ምድርን እሰልል ዘንድ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በላከኝ ጊዜ እኔ የአርባ ዓመት ሰው ነበርሁ፤ እኔም በልቡ የነበረውን ቃል መለስሁለት።
ከእኔ ጋር የወጡ ወንድሞች ግን የሕዝቡን ልብ አስካዱ፤ እኔ ግን አምላኬን እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሜ እከተለው ዘንድ ተመለስሁ።
ሙሴም በዚያ ቀን፦ ‘አምላኬን እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽመህ ተከትለሃልና እግርህ የረገጠው ምድር ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ለዘለዓለም በርግጥ ርስት ይሆናል’ ብሎ ማለ።
አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ ይህን ቃል ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ እስራኤል በምድረ በዳ ሲዞሩ፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገረኝ እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አርባ አምስት ዓመታት በሕይወት አኖረኝ፤ አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ለእኔ ዛሬ ሰማንያ አምስት ዓመት ሆነኝ።
ሙሴም በላከኝ ጊዜ ጽኑዕ እንደ ነበርሁ፥ ዛሬም ገና እንዲሁ ለመዋጋት ለመውጣትም ለመግባትም ጽኑዕ ነኝ።
አሁን እንግዲህ በዚያ ቀን እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ይህን ተራራማ ሀገር ስጠኝ፤ አንተ በዚያ ቀን ዔናቃውያን፥ ታላላቆችና የተመሸጉ ከተሞችም በዚያ እንዳሉ ሰምተህ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ጋር ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረኝ አጠፋቸዋለሁ።”
ኢያሱም የቄኔዝ ልጅ፥ የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብን ባረከው፤ ኬብሮንንም ርስት አድርጎ ሰጠው።
ስለዚህም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሞ ስለ ተከተለ ኬብሮን እስከ ዛሬ ለቄኔዛዊው ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ ርስት ሆነች።
የኬብሮንም ስም አስቀድሞ የአርቦቅ ከተማ ትባል ነበር፤ እርስዋም የዔናቃውያን ዋና ከተማ ነበረች። ምድሪቱም ከውጊያ ዐረፈች።

sections.title: The inheritance given to the tribe of Judah.

verses.text: The border of the tribe of Judah shall extend along its borders from Edom to the wilderness of Zin, beginning at the south to the city of Kadesh.
And on the southern side, their border shall be to the salt sea, and the way that leads to Libnah shall be their boundary.

From there, it shall go out toward the west; it shall go out to Zin; it shall extend southward to the gate of Kadesh; it shall pass to Asron; and it shall go out to Seradah, and it shall turn toward the west to Kadesh.
And it shall not pass to Azmon; it shall go out toward the river of Egypt; and the exit of the border shall be by the sea; this is the border on the southern side.
And on the eastern side, their border shall be to the salt sea and to the Jordan; and on the northern side, their border shall extend to the end of the Jordan, even to the sea of the tongue.
From there, their border shall go out to the house of Gelalim; it shall not pass to the north of Betaraba; and their border shall go out to the son of Reuben, to the city of Liton.

Their border shall go out to the fourth part of the river of Achor; it shall go out before the face of Adumim, toward the south, and it shall descend to Gelgela; and their border shall not pass to the fountain of the sun; and the exit shall be near the fountain of Rogel.

Their border shall go out by the river of Hinnom, near Jerusalem, toward the south; and their border shall go out on the north side, at the valley of Rephaim, near the river of Hinnom, facing the sea.
Their border shall go from the head of the mountain to the fountain of Nephto; it shall reach the mountain of Ephron; it shall reach the city of Jearim and to Baalah.

Their border shall not pass to Baalah on the sea; from there, it shall go southward to the city of Jearim and northward to Kisalon, and it shall not pass to the border of Ashtor; it shall descend upon the city of the sun; it shall not pass to Libnah.

The boundary shall go out toward the south to Acaron; and it shall turn toward the north; the boundary shall go out to the west; and it shall pass toward the south; on the left and on the right it shall go out; and the boundary shall be by the edge of the sea.
The boundary which is by the sea shall extend to the great sea and to the border thereof. For the children of Judah, this is their boundary according to their families round about.

sections.title: Caleb took Hebron and Debir as he had promised.

verses.text: And the Lord commanded that the portion be given to Jephunneh's son Caleb among the children of Judah; and he gave him the city of Arba, which is the chief city of Anak. She is Hebron.
And Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, destroyed the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
And afterward, Caleb arose against the inhabitants of Debir; and the name of Debir was formerly called "The City of Books."
And Caleb said, "To him who attacks the City of Books and captures it, I will give my daughter Achsah as a wife."
And Caleb's brother, the son of Kenaz, Othniel, captured it; and he gave him his daughter Achsah as a wife.
And she came to him and said, "Give me a blessing; for you have given me a land in the Negev, and now give me also springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
And she said, "Give me a blessing; for you have given me a land in the south, and now also give me the springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

sections.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Judah.

verses.text: This is the inheritance of the children of Judah by their clans.
In the southern part of their land, as far as the border of Edom, these were the cities of the children of Judah: Bezalel, Arad, and Ashor;
Ekam, Regma, and Aruheil;
Qades, and Asorios; their dwellings;
and their villages;
The cities of Asharim also belong to her, for she is Ashor.
Sin, Selama, and Moladah;
Serai, and Bephalad;
Kolaseol, and Beersheba, and their villages.
Bala, and Baqob, and Asom;
Elbohidah, Bethel, and Ermam;
Seqelak, Makerimr, Setunak;
Labos Saleh, Ermot, and the cities and villages of Hayazeten;
Bekolaw, Astal, Sara'a, Asa;
Rame, Tano, Idutot, Mehanes;
Ermut, Edolam, Membra, Saak, Azika;
Seqarm, Gadarn, and their settlements, ten and four cities and their villages;
Sena, Adason, Magadalgad;
Adolal, Mesefa, Yiqarul, Lekis;
Besedot Yideha, Delyam;
ኮብራ፥ ማኬስ፥ መሐኮስም፤
ጌዶር፥ በጋድያል፥ ኖማን፥ መቄዶም፥ ዐሥራ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።
ሌምና፥ ኤተቅ፥ አኖክ፥
ኢድና ናሲብም፤
ኤላም፥ አቁዛም፥ ኬዜብ ቴርሳ፥ ኤሎምም፥ ዐሥር ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።
አቃሮን ከመንደሮችዋና ከመሰማሪያዎችዋ ጋር።
ከአቃሮንና ከጌምና ጀምሮ በአሴዶት አቅራቢያ ያሉ ሁሉና መንደሮቻቸው፤
አሴያዶት መንደሮችዋና መሰማሪያዎችዋም፥ ጋዛም መንደሮችዋና መሰማሪያዎችዋም እስከ ግብፅ ወንዝ ድረስ፥ ታላቁ ባሕርም ወሰኑ ነው።
የሳምር ተራራዎች ፥ ኢዩቴር፥ ሦካ፤
ሬና፥ የመጽሐፍ ሀገር የሆነች ዳቤር፤
Anon, Sekema, Esamam;
Gosom, Kelum, and eleven cities and their villages.
Erem, Remna, Soma;
Iyamayim, Betakum, Faquh;
Euma, the city of Arboq, and it is also Hebron, Soret, with nine cities and their villages.
Mahor, Carmel, Azib, Itan;
Iyareyel, Iyariqem, and Zaqayim;
Gabba, Temna, with nine cities and their villages.
Alewa, Betesur, Gedor;
Ma'arat, Betanot, Eltoqon, with six cities and their villages.

And Tekoa, Ephrathah, is indeed the house of Bethlehem; and also Fagor, and Etan, and Kulon, and Teton, and Sobhem, and Qarem, and Gelem, and Eter, and Menekom, and eleven cities and their villages; Kiryat Baal, which is indeed the city of Jearim; and Sobeta, the two cities and their villages.
And Badargis, and Terabiam, and Enon; and Sekewazan.
And Naphlaz and its cities; Sidon, and Aqades, and seven cities and their villages.
But the Jebusites who dwelt in Jerusalem could not be driven out by the children of Judah; and the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah in Jerusalem unto this day.

sections.title: A heritage given equally to Ephraim and Manasseh.

verses.text: And the children of Joseph, from the region near Jericho, towards the east, shall reach unto the house that was in Bethel, which is beyond the Jordan, and shall be in the wilderness and towards the mountainous region, even unto the place called Luz.
From Bethel unto Luz, towards the border of the land of the Canaanites, shall they reach unto the region of Ataroth.
And towards the west, even unto the border of the Philistines, and unto the border of the lower Bethhoron, shall it descend; and the outlet shall be by the sea.
And the children of Joseph, even Manasseh and Ephraim, did inherit their inheritance.

sections.title: The inheritance of the children of Ephraim.

verses.text: The borders of the children of Ephraim were as follows, according to their clans: the border of their inheritance was from Ataroth and from Erhon eastward, as far as the upper Bethoron.
And the border went westward to the sea, and it extended to the north of Termah; and it went eastward to Tinas and Selas, and it did not pass from the east to Enoch.
From Enoch it extended to Meacon, and to Ataroth, and it did not pass to their dwellings; and it reached Jericho and went out to the Jordan.
The border extended from its side to the sea as far as Kelkan and the river; and the exit was by the edge of the sea. This was the inheritance of the children of Ephraim according to their clans.
Thus, among the inheritances of the children of Manasseh, the cities of Ephraim were distinct, along with all their dwellings.
And in Gezer, the Canaanites who dwelt there did not Ephraim drive out; and even to this day, the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites, and they have become servants.

sections.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Manasseh is as follows.

verses.text: This is the boundary of the children of Manasseh; for he is the firstborn of Joseph. And Machir, the father of Gilead, because he was a mighty warrior, had Gilead and Bashan.

And the lot was for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families: for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida; these are the male descendants by their families.
For the children of Hepher, there were female descendants; but there were no male descendants. And the names of the daughters of Zelophehad are: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

And they came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the rulers, saying, “The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren.” And by the command of the Lord, they were given an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
And their lot was ten portions, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan.
For the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among their brethren; and the land of Gilead was for the rest of the children of Manasseh.
The boundary of the children of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which lies before Shechem; and the boundary went along to the right hand toward the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

And the border descended toward the south side of the river Kanah, southward; these cities are the inheritance of the children of Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh; the border of Manasseh was on the north side toward the river, and the exit was by the sea.
The southern boundary was for Ephraim, and the northern boundary was for Manasseh; the border was by the sea, and on the north side it reached to Asher, and on the east side it reached to Issachar.
And between Issachar and Asher were Beth-shean and its towns, and Dor and its towns, and Megiddo and its towns, and the third is Naphoth-dor, which belonged to Manasseh.
And the children of Manasseh caused the people of these cities to perish; yet they came to dwell in that land with the Canaanites.
And the children of Israel were strong; they possessed the Canaanites; yet they did not utterly drive them out.

sections.title: And the tribe of Ephraim and the tribe of Manasseh sought additional inheritance.

verses.text: And the sons of Joseph said unto him, “Behold, we are a numerous people; why then hath God blessed us with but one portion, and only one inheritance?” Thus they spake unto him.
And he said unto them, “If ye be a numerous people, then the mountainous land of Ephraim is too narrow for you; go ye up to the forest and clear a place for yourselves there.”

And they answered, “The mountainous land of Ephraim is not enough for us; for the Canaanites who dwell in the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth-shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
And Joshua said unto the sons of Joseph, “If ye be a numerous people, and if ye be strong, one portion shall not be enough for you;

Nevertheless, the mountainous land shall be yours; though it be a forest, ye shall clear it; for it shall be yours; and if the Canaanites have chariots of iron and are strong, yet ye shall drive them out until ye have conquered them.”

sections.title: The division of the remaining inheritance.

verses.text: And the children of Israel gathered together at Shiloh; and there they set up the tabernacle of the congregation, and the land was subdued before them.
And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, “How long are ye slack to go to possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?”
Of every tribe ye shall send three men, and they shall rise and go through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come again to me.
They shall divide it into seven parts; Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coast on the north.
And ye shall therefore divide the land into seven portions; and bring me word again here, and I will cast lots for you before the Lord our God.

But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance; and Gad, and Reuben, and the half tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
And the men arose and went; and Joshua charged them, saying, “Go, walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me; and I will cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.”
And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book; and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord; and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

sections.title: The inheritance given to the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.text: The border of the tribe of Benjamin went out according to their clans; and their territory went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

To the north, their border began at the Jordan; and the border went up to the ascent of Jericho on the north side, and then went up through the mountainous country to the sea; and the exit was at the wilderness of Bethaven.
And the border went southward to Bethel and passed by Luz; and the border descended to the mountain that is on the south side of Bethoron, and went down to Maachatharoth.

The border went toward the sea; and in front of Bethoron there was a mountain, and it went toward the north; and the exit was at Kirjatharim, which is in the city of the children of Judah, and this was toward the sea.
The southern border was at the end of Kirjatharim; and the border went down to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah.

The border went down to the end of the valley of Hinnom, which is in front of the mountain on the south side; and it is at the north of the valley of Rephaim; and it went down to the valley of Hinnom and to the south of the city of Jebus, which is Jerusalem, and it went down to the spring of Rogel.
And it did not pass by the house of Asmaveth; but it went in front of the house of Itamim, and it went toward Keliah; and it descended to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben.
To the north, it did not pass by the house of Rabah; but it went down to the sea road.
The boundary of their territory extended to the north toward the salt sea; and to the south, their border was the Jordan. This is the border that lies to the south.
To the east, the border was the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their clans.
The children of Benjamin, according to their clans, were these cities: Jericho, Beth-Hoglah, and Emek-Keziz;
Beth-Barah, Zer, and Beersheba;
Aijalon, Gibeah, and Ephraim;
Karathar, Kephirah, Mony, and Gabah; there were twelve cities and their villages.
Gibeon, Ramah, and Beeroth;
Mizpeh, Beron, and Amok;
Beriah, Kephar, Nacah, Selah, and Taralah;

Jerusalem, which is called the city of the Jebusites, and the city of Aijalon, Gibeon; there were thirty-three cities and their villages. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their clans.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Simeon.

verses.text: And the second portion was for the children of Simeon, according to their families; their inheritance was among the children of Judah.
And these were their cities: Beersheba, Shema, Moladah;
Hazarshual, Balah, Ezem;
Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah;
Ziklag, Bethmarcaboth, Hazarsusah;
And their villages and their fields, thirty-three cities and their hamlets;
Rimmon, Telah, Ither, Ashan; four cities and their hamlets;

Even unto Baal, all the cities round about these were their hamlets. This was the inheritance of the children of Simeon according to their families, which was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

The portion of the children of Simeon was taken from the children of Judah, for the inheritance of the children of Judah was too much for them; therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance among their inheritance.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Zebulun.

verses.text: And the third lot came out for the children of Zebulun according to their families; and their border was as far as to the shore of Sidon.
And their border went toward the west side to Maralah; and it reached to the house of Rabah; and it extended to the brook that is before Jachin.
And it turned from Zebulun to the east toward the house of Samis, and it reached to the border of Casiloth; and it went out to Dabereoth; and it reached to Panhim.
And from there it went to Gheber, eastward, and it passed to the city of Kattash; and it went to Rimmon and to Matarion.
And the border was toward the north side to Amoth; and the exit was at Hanath, at the brook of Gephah.
Katnath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem; these are twelve cities and their villages.
The children of Zebulun had these cities and their villages as their inheritance according to their families.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Zebulun.

verses.text: አራተኛውም ዕጣ ለይሳኮር ልጆች ወጣ።
ድንበራቸውም ኢይዝራኤል፥ ከልሰሉት፥ ሱሳን፤
አጊን፥ ሴዎንና፥ ርሄቱ፥
አንከሬት፥ ዳቤሮት፥ ቂሶን፥ ሮቤስ፤
ሬማስ፥ ያዖን፥ ቶማን፥ ኤሜሬቅ፥ ቤርሳፌስ ነበረ።
ድንበራቸውም ወደ ታቦርና ወደ ሰሌም፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ቤተሳሚስ ይደርሳል፤ የድንበራቸው መውጫም ዮርዳኖስ ነበረ፤ ዐሥራ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸውም።
የይሳኮር ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

sections.title: A heritage given to Asher.

verses.text: The fifth lot was for the children of Asher, according to their families.
Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph;
And Amimelech, Amehel, and Mahsah were there; towards the sea, they reached Carmel, and to the cities of the Sidonians.

And towards the sun's rising, it extended to the house of the inheritance; on the side of Zebulun and the valley of Jiphthahel, it reached to the house of Mehetab; and to Enhil it reached; and to the coast of Mashomel it passed;
From there it went to Hebron, and to Rehob, and to Amemah, and to Kentan, as far as the great Sidon.
And the border went to Ramah, and to Mespha's spring, and to Tyre; and the border went to Iasaph; and the exit was towards the sea, in the direction of Leban and Kozab;
And Arkob, and Apheq, and Rehob were also there; twenty-two cities and their villages.
The children of Asher had this inheritance, according to their families; these are the cities and their villages.

sections.title: A heritage given to the inheritors.

verses.text: And the sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, according to their families.
And their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan.
And the border turned westward to Aznothtabor; and went out from thence to Hukok; and it extended southward to Zebulun, and westward to Asher, and ended at Jordan toward the sunrising.
And the cities that were fortified were these: Zidon, and Hamath, and Accho,
and Aram, and Arah, and Assur,
and Kedesh, and Edrei, which is the source of Assur,
and Iron, and Migdal-el, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; these are the eighteen cities and their villages.
This is the inheritance of the children of Naphtali according to their cities and their villages.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Dan.

verses.text: And the seventh came forth to the children of Dan.
And this was their inheritance: the city of Zorah, and the city of Eshtaol, and the city of Shamir,
And Aijalon, and Ethlah,
And Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron,
And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
And Jarmuth, and Adullam, and Socoh;
And along the sea, facing Joppa, they had a border with the coast of the sea.

The children of Dan had their inheritance by their families, these cities and their villages according to their tribes. And the children of Dan did not distress the Amorites that dwelt in the mountain; for the Amorites would not suffer them to come down to the valley. And they took one part of the inheritance from them.

And the children of Dan went to fight against Leshem, and they took it; and they smote it with the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein. And they called the name of it Dan, after the name of their father, Dan. And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim; yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Iyasus.

verses.text: And after they had divided the land according to its borders, the children of Israel gave a heritage to Jehu, the son of Hanani, in the midst of them, by the command of the Lord.
They gave to the city called Timnas Serah, which is in the mountainous land of Ephraim, the city that they desired; and the city was built and settled therein.

This is the heritage that was given by the priest Eleazar, and Jehu, the son of Nimshi, and the leaders of the tribes of the children of Israel, before the Lord in Shiloh, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they divided the land by lot.

sections.title: Cities of Refuge

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው፦ በሙሴ ቃል የነገርኋችሁን የመማፀኛ ከተሞችን ስጡ።
ባለማወቅ ሳይወድድ ሰውን የገደለ በዚያ ይማፀን ዘንድ፥ ለእናንተ የመማፀኛ ከተሞችን ሥሩ፤ ነፍስ የገደለ ሰውም በአደባባይ ለፍርድ እስኪቀርብ ድረስ በደም ተበቃዩ አይገደል።
ከእነዚህም ከተሞች በአንዲቱ ይማፀናል፤ በከተማዪቱም በር አደባባይ ቆሞ ለከተማዪቱ ሽማግሌዎች ነገሩን ይናገራል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ከተማዪቱ ያገቡታል። የሚቀመጥበትም ስፍራ ይሰጡታል።
ባለ ደሙ ቢያሳድደው፥ አስቀድሞ ሳይጠላው ባልንጀራውን በስሕተት ስለ ገደለው ነፍሰ ገዳዩን በእጁ አሳልፈው አይስጡት።
በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስኪቆም ድረስ ፥ በዚያም ወራት ያለው ታላቁ ካህን እስኪሞት ድረስ በዚያች ከተማ ይቀመጥ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ይመለሳል፤ ወደ ከተማውም፥ ወደ ቤቱም ሸሽቶ ወደ ወጣበትም ከተማ ይገባል።”
በንፍታሌም ባለው በተራራማው ሀገር በገሊላ ቃዴስን፥ በኤፍሬምም ባለው በተራራማው ሀገር ሴኬምን፥ በይሁዳም ባለው በተራራማው ሀገር ኬብሮን የምትባለውን የአርቦቅን ከተማ ለዩ።
በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ምሥራቅ ከሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳው በደልዳላው ስፍራ ቦሶርን፥ ከጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ኤርሞትን፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ጎላንን ለዩ።
በማኅበሩ ፊት እስኪቆምና እስኪመረመር ድረስ ባለደሙ እንዳይገድለው ሳያውቅ ሰውን የገደለ ወደዚያ እንዲማፀን፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ፥ በመካካላቸውም ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ የተመረጡ ከተሞች እነዚህ ናቸው።

sections.title: Cities given to the Levites.

verses.text: The leaders of the children of Levi came to the priest, to Eleazar, and to Ithamar, the son of Aaron, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, the heads of the fathers' houses.

In the land of Canaan, which is in Shechem, they spoke, saying, "The Lord commanded us through the hand of Moses to give cities for our dwellings, and for our cattle, we ask for the cities to be given to us."
And the children of Israel, according to the command of the Lord, gave these cities and their pasture lands to the Levites.
And for the families of the children of Kohath, they gave cities from the tribe of Judah, from the tribe of Simeon, and from the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities in all were given to them.
And for the rest of the children of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan, and from the tribe of Manasseh, ten cities in all were given to them.

And for the children of Gershon, from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, and from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities in all were given to them.
And for the children of Merari, according to their families, from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities were given to them.
And the Lord commanded Moses, and the children of Israel gave these cities and their pasture lands to the Levites by lot.
The children of Judah, and the children of Simeon, and the children of Benjamin, gave these cities to them by name.
The first lot came out for them, and the children of Levi were given cities of refuge, which were for the sons of Aaron, who were of the family of Kohath.
The sons of Enak gave them the city of Kiriath-arba and its surrounding villages; this is Hebron, which is located in the hill country of Judah.
And he gave the fields and the villages of the city to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as a heritage.
And to the priest, to the sons of Aaron, he gave these; the city of Hebron, which is a refuge city for the slayer, and its surrounding villages; and Libnah and its surrounding villages.
And Ether and its surrounding villages; and Atam and its surrounding villages;
And Helon and its surrounding villages; and Debir and its surrounding villages;
And Asan and its surrounding villages; and Jotah and its surrounding villages; and Beth-shemesh and its surrounding villages; from these, he gave nine cities from the two families.
And from the tribe of Benjamin, he gave Geba and its surrounding villages; and Gathrimmon and its surrounding villages;
And Anathoth and its surrounding villages; and Almon and its surrounding villages; he gave four cities.
The cities of the priests, the sons of Aaron, are thirteen in all, with their surrounding villages.
And for the rest of the Levites, for the children of Kohath, he gave cities from the tribe of Ephraim.
To the city of refuge, which is Shechem and its suburbs, and to Gezer and its suburbs;
And to Kibzaim and its suburbs, and to Betheron and its suburbs; these four cities were given to them.
From Dan, and from the way of El-kon, and its suburbs, and to Gabbathon and its suburbs;
To Elon and its suburbs, and to Geterahmon and its suburbs; these four cities were given to them.
From Manasseh, the way of Ibleam and its suburbs, and to Jabneel and its suburbs; these two cities were given to them.
The rest of the children of the sons of Aaron were ten cities with their suburbs.

And to the Levites, for the children of Gershon, from Manasseh, the way of Ibleam, to the city of refuge, which is Golan and its suburbs, and to Bosor and its suburbs; these two cities were given to them.
From Issachar, and from the way of Kishon and its suburbs, and to Daberath and its suburbs;
To Remeth and its suburbs, and to Ain-ganim and its suburbs; these four cities were given to them.
From Asher, the way of Mishel and its suburbs, and to Abdon and its suburbs;
They gave to Helkath and its pasture, Rehob and its pasture; they gave the four cities to them.
From Naphthali, they gave the cities of Kedesh and its pasture, Emmath and its pasture, and Kartan and its pasture, three cities in all.
The children of Gilead received cities, each according to their clans, three cities with their pasture.
To the remainder of the Levites, to the children of Merari, they gave the cities of Jokneam and its pasture, Kedesh and its pasture,
Dimnah and its pasture, Selah and its pasture; they gave four cities to them.
On the side of the Jordan, near Jericho, from the tribe of Reuben, they gave the cities of Bosor and its pasture, and of Iazer and its pasture;
Kedemoth and its pasture, Mephaath and its pasture; they gave four cities to them.
From Gad, they gave the cities of Ramoth and its pasture, and of Gilead and its pasture, in the region of Gilead.
Heshbon and its pasture, and of Jazer and its pasture; they gave four cities to them.
The remaining cities of the children of Merari, from the Levite clans, these were all their cities; and their portion was twelve cities.
Among the cities of the Levites, which were given as inheritance among the children of Israel, there were forty-eight cities, along with their surrounding pasturelands.

These cities were each with their surrounding pasturelands; thus were all these cities. [And Joshua divided the land according to their borders. And the children of Israel gave to Joshua the city which he desired, which was Timnath-serah, situated in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt therein. And Joshua took the stones which were hewn from the rock and brought them to Timnath-serah.]

sections.title: And Israel shall possess the land, and they shall find rest therein.

verses.text: And the Lord gave unto them the land which He had sworn unto their fathers, and they inherited it, and dwelt therein.
And the Lord delivered them from all their enemies round about, so that none of their adversaries could stand against them; and the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
All that the Lord had spoken concerning the house of Israel came to pass; there remained not a word of all His good promise, which He had promised by the hand of His servant.

sections.title: And Jesus, having come from the region of Jordan, was baptized.

verses.text: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ የሮቤልን ልጆችና የጋድን ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኩሌታ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦
“የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ሰምታችኋል፤ እኔም ላዘዝኋችሁ ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዛችኋል፤
ይህንም ያህል ብዙ ጊዜ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንድሞቻችሁን አልተዋችሁም፤ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቃችኋል።
አሁንም አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራቸው ወንድሞቻችሁን አሳርፎአቸዋል፤ አሁን እንግዲህ ተመለሱ፤ ወደ ቤታችሁና የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ሰጣችሁ ወደ ርስታችሁ ምድር ሂዱ።
ብቻ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ትእዛዙንና ሕጉን ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርንም ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገዱንም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንም ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ እርሱንም ትከተሉ ዘንድ፥ በፍጹምም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ታመልኩት ዘንድ እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ።”
ኢያሱም መረቃቸው፤ አሰናበታቸውም፤ ወደ ቤታቸውም ሄዱ።
ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሙሴ በባሳን ውስጥ ርስት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር፤ ለቀረው ለእኩሌታው ግን ኢያሱ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በባሕር በኩል በወንድሞቻቸው መካከል ርስት ሰጣቸው። ኢያሱም ወደ ቤታቸው በአሰናበታቸው ጊዜ እንዲህ ብሎ መረቃቸው፦
“በብዙ ብልጥግና፥ በእጅግም ብዙ ከብት፥ በብርም፥ በወርቅም፥ በናስም፥ በብረትም፥ በእጅግም ብዙ ልብስ ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ፤ የጠላቶቻችሁንም ምርኮ ከወንድሞቻችሁ ጋር ተካፈሉ።”
የሮቤልም ልጆች የጋድም ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሄዱ፤ በሙሴም እጅ በተሰጠ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ተቀበሉት ወደ ርስታቸው ወደ ገለዓድ ምድር ይገቡ ዘንድ በከነዓን ምድር ካለችው ከሴሎ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

sections.title: A sanctuary that was made by the Jordan.

verses.text: በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ አቅራቢያም ወደ ገለዓድ በመጡ ጊዜ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ በዚያ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ የሚታይ ታላቅ መሠዊያ ሠሩ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከነዓን ምድር ዳርቻ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ባለው በገለዓድ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ባሉበት ወገን፥ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ መሠዊያ እንደ ሠሩ ሰሙ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ወጥተው እነርሱን ሊዋጉ በሴሎ ተሰበሰቡ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች በገለዓድ ምድር ወዳሉት ወደ ሮቤል ልጆችና ወደ ጋድ ልጆች ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ የካህኑ የአሮንን ልጅ የአልዓዛርን ልጅ ፊንሐስን ላኩ።
ዐሥር አለቆችም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፤ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ አንድ አንድ የእየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ፤ እያንዳንዱም በእስራኤል አእላፋት መካከል የአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ ነበረ።
በገለዓድም ምድር ወዳሉት ወደ ሮቤል ልጆችና ወደ ጋድ ልጆች፥ ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ደረሱ፤ እንዲህም ብለው ነገሩአቸው
የእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ሁሉ የሚለው ይህ ነው፥ “ዛሬ እግዚአብሔርን መከተልን ትተዉ ዘንድ፥ መሠዊያም ትሠሩ ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ዛሬ ትክዱት ዘንድ ይህ በእስራኤል አምላክ ፊት ያደረጋችሁት ኀጢአት ምንድን ነው?
እኛ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከእርሱ ያልነጻንበት የፌጎር ኀጢአት ጥቂት ነውን? በእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ላይ መቅሠፍት ወረደ።
እናንተ ዛሬ እግዚአብሔርን መከተልን ትታችኋል፤ ዛሬ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ብታምፁ ነገ በእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ መቅሠፍት ይሆናል።
ነገር ግን የርስታችሁ ምድር ቢያንሳችሁ የእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ወደሚቀመጥበት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ርስት ምድር አልፋችሁ ከእኛ ጋር ውረሱ፤ ከአምላካችንም ከእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ውጭ ለእናንተ መሠዊያ ሠርታችኋልና እግዚአብሔርን አትካዱ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አትተዉት።
የዛራ ልጅ አካን እርም ነገር በመውሰድ ኀጢአትን ስለ ሠራ በእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ ቍጣ አልወረደምን? እርሱም ብቻውን ቢበድል በኀጢአቱ ብቻውን ሞተን?”
የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ለእስራኤል አእላፋት አለቆች እንዲህ ብለው መለሱላቸው፦
“እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነው፤ ጌታም ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር የአማልክት አምላክ ነው፤ እርሱ ያውቃል። እስራኤልም ያውቀዋል። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያደረግነው ለበደልና ለመካድ ከሆነ ዛሬ አያድነን፤
አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንድንክደው፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህልን ቍርባን እንድናሳርግበት፥ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት እንድናቀርብበት መሠዊያ ሠርተን እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ራሱ ይመራመረን፤
ይልቁንም ከልባችን ፍርሀት የተነሣ፦ ነገ ልጆቻችሁ ልጆቻችንን፦ ከእስራኤል ልጆች አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ምን አላችሁ? እንዳይሉአቸው ስለፈራን ይህን የሠራነው ካልሆነ፥ እናንተ የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ፥
እግዚአብሔር በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ዮርዳኖስን ድንበር አድርጎአልና በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ዕድል ፋንታ የላችሁም ይሉአቸዋል፤ በዚሁም ልጆቻችሁ ልጆቻችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከማምለክ እንዳያወጡአቸው ብለን ይህን አደረግን።
ስለዚህም መሠዊያ እንሥራ አልን፤ ነገር ግን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ለቍርባን አይደለም፤
ነገር ግን በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል፥ ከእኛም በኋላ በትውልዳችንና በትውልዳችሁ መካከል በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና በቍርባን፥ በደኅንነትም መሥዋዕታችን እግዚአብሔርን እናመልክ ዘንድ፥ ነገ ልጆቻችሁ ልጆቻችንን፦ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ዕድል ፋንታ የላችሁም እንዳይሉ ምስክር ይሆናል።
ኋላ ይህ በተደረገ ጊዜ ነገ ለእኛ ወይም ለትውልዳችን ይህን ሲሉ፥ እኛ፦ እነሆ፥ አባቶቻችን ያደረጉትን የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ ምሳሌ እዩ፤ በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ምስክር ነው እንጂ ስለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ስለ ቍርባን አይደለም እንላለን።
በድንኳኑ ፊት ካለው ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሌላ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ለሰላም መሥዋዕት፥ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕትም የሚሆን መሠዊያን የሠራነው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ በማመፅ እግዚአብሔርንም ዛሬ መከተልን ለመተው በማለት እንደ ሆነ ይህ ከእኛ ይራቅ።”

And the priest Phinehas, and the leaders of the congregation who were with him, and all the children of Israel, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, when they heard the words that were spoken, they were silent; and their hearts were gladdened.

And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben and to the children of Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, “This day we know that the Lord is among us, for you have not committed this trespass against the Lord; and you have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.”

And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, and the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, returned from the land of Gilead unto the land of Canaan, unto the children of Israel; and they brought them word again.

And the words pleased the children of Israel; and they blessed the Lord, and did not speak of going up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and the children of Gad dwelt.
And he called the altar, “A witness between us,” for he said, “It is a witness between us that the Lord is God.”

sections.title: The discourse of Isaiah.

verses.text: And it came to pass, after many days, that the Lord God delivered Israel from all their enemies that were round about them; and Joshua was old and stricken in years.
And Joshua called for all the children of Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, “Behold, I am old and stricken in age.”
And you, the Lord your God, who is before you, has not forsaken you concerning all that He has done for you among these nations; for He is the Lord your God.
Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, from the Jordan unto the Great Sea westward, as an inheritance for your tribes.

Your God, the Lord, will drive them out from before you until they be destroyed; and He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall drive them out from before you; your God, the Lord, has spoken, and you shall inherit their land.
You shall observe to do all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, that you turn not aside from it to the right hand or to the left.
And among you, do not associate with these nations; neither call upon the names of their gods, nor make mention of them, nor serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them.
But until this day, follow the Lord your God as He has done for you.
